description: This file defines a FastAPI web application for a personal journal management system. It includes endpoints for creating, reading, updating, listing, verifying, and deleting journal entries, with support for both JSON and multipart form data including image uploads. It also contains health and diagnostic endpoints, request inspection, and static file handling. The file utilizes SQLModel for database interactions and applies CORS middleware for frontend integration.
